supplementary_review.hardware_identifiers: Real system profiler records contain model/chip/memory/firmware information without serial or hardware UUID. Fake serial/UUID literals occur in doctor/backend redaction tests; historical versions reviewed.
supplementary_review.identity: Owner author/committer Gmail and /Users/artemlegotin paths are authorized public identity/provenance; retained. Other real emails are upstream dependency license attribution.
supplementary_review.uuid_review: Only deliberately fake test UUID in two historical test_doctor.py blobs. General UUID shape checked including non-RFC placeholders.
supplementary_review.binary_origin: Widened rounding fixture is generated by torch.manual_seed(1602042) and torch.randn in retained diagnose.py; causal seed42 fixture is toy synthetic recipe per companion Markdown; native-final checkpoint configs declare data.dataset synthetic; NPZ provenance documents synthetic teacher/splits and independent exploratory E stream.
supplementary_review.binary_limitations: No torch.load or pickle.loads used. Archive metadata, pickletools opcode parsing, NPY header parsing and producer/provenance code support synthetic origin; numeric payloads were not regenerated or exhaustively analyzed for covert data.
